home.title: See if the CalFresh work rule applies to you
home.subtitle: Answer a few short questions. It takes about 2 minutes.
home.cta: Check if the rule applies to you
home.demoNeedsJs: The demo needs JavaScript turned on in your browser.
home.demoNeedsStorage: The demo needs your browser to allow site storage.

checklist.title: Do any of these apply to you?

result.notDecision: This is not a decision. Only your county can decide.
result.sayIntro: When you call, you can say:

not_subject.title: The rule likely doesn't apply to you.
not_subject.body: You don't need to report work hours for this rule right now.

possibly_exempt.title: You may be exempt. Ask your county to confirm.
possibly_exempt.body: Tell your county about your situation. They will check whether the rule applies to you.

likely_exempt.title: You're likely exempt.
likely_exempt.body: Based on what you told us, you likely don't need to meet the work rule.

meeting_requirement.title: The rule applies to you, and right now you're meeting it. Keep proof of every hour.
meeting_requirement.body: Save records for every hour of work, volunteering, or an approved program.

subject.title: The rule likely applies to you. At your next CalFresh renewal, you may need 80 hours a month of work, volunteering or an approved program.
subject.body: Start tracking now so you have proof ready. Ask your county when it starts for you.

ask_county.title: We can't tell from your answers. Your county can.
ask_county.body: Contact your county for help figuring out if the rule applies to you.

pace.pastEmpty: This month is over. No hours were saved for it.

notes.title: Good to know
notes.job_search_outside_program: Job search on your own doesn't count. It only counts as part of a job program, like CalFresh E&T, WIOA or Trade Act.
notes.job_search_no_program: Job search counts only as part of a job program. None of these hours count this month.
notes.job_search_capped: Some of your job search hours aren't counted here. In a job program, job search counts only while it is less than your other program hours. Ask your program if yours is different.
notes.workfare_mixed: Workfare can't be added to your other hours, so the ring doesn't count it. Your county sets your workfare hours from your benefit amount. Ask them how many you need.
notes.workfare_only: The ring doesn't count workfare. Your county sets your workfare hours from your benefit amount. Ask them how many you need.

log.empty: No hours saved for this month yet.
log.emptyWhat: What counts: paid work, volunteering, and job training programs. Tap “Add hours” after each shift.
log.savedOnPhone: Your hours are saved only on this phone.
log.offline: Your hours stay saved on this phone, even without signal.
log.checkRule: Check if the rule applies to you

work.label: Paid work
work.hint: A job, gig work, or working for yourself

volunteer.label: Volunteering
volunteer.hint: Unpaid work for a nonprofit or community group

job_search.label: Job search
job_search.hint: Looking for and applying to jobs

workfare.label: Workfare
workfare.hint: Work your county gives you for your benefits

form.inProgramHint: Like CalFresh E&T, WIOA or Trade Act. Job search only counts when it is part of one.
form.deleteConfirm: Delete this entry? You can't undo this.
form.saveError: Couldn't save on this phone. Please try again.

errors.bad_date: Pick a date that is today or earlier.
errors.bad_hours: Enter hours from 0.25 to 24, in quarter hours (like 1.5).
errors.too_many_hours_that_day: That's more than 24 hours on this day, counting your other entries for it.
errors.in_program_only_for_job_search: Only job search can be marked as part of a job program.

rule.title: How the rule works
rule.adds: If the rule applies to you, you need 80 hours a month. Work, volunteering and job programs add up.
rule.jobSearch: Job search counts only as part of a job program. Workfare is checked differently by your county.
rule.report: If the rule applies to you and your hours drop below 20 a week on average (80 a month), tell your county within 10 days.

proof.title: Your proof
proof.intro: Keep photos and PDF files that show your hours, one box for each kind of activity. When your county asks for proof, you send or bring these yourself.
proof.anyProof: Your county can't require one specific kind of proof. Pay stubs, program attendance records and signed letters are all examples.
proof.loadError: This browser can't open saved files here. Private browsing or blocked site storage can cause this.

errors.bad_type: {name} wasn't added. Only photos and PDF files can be added.
errors.save: {name} wasn't added. This phone may be out of storage.

cf888.why: Volunteer hours have to be verified. One way is California's CF 888 form, signed by someone at the organization.
cf888.heading: CF 888 for {place}
cf888.privacy: What you type here only goes into the PDF on this phone. It isn't saved or sent anywhere.
cf888.name: Your full name
cf888.hoursHelp: From your log. The organization's representative checks this number.
cf888.error: The PDF couldn't be made. Try again, or use the blank form.
cf888.next: Next: ask the organization's representative to check the hours, fill in their part and sign. Then add a photo of the signed form in the Volunteering box.
